transcript.content: I recently came out as lesbian to some friends at Comic Con; their initial silence made me believe they now hate me and think I am immoral, which causes me great pain and worry.
[System A Baseline] 我听到了您的陈述:'我最近在Comic Con上向一些朋友坦白自己是Female同性恋,她们最初的Silence让我相信'.请继续分享您的想法.
